data_provenance.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
data_provenance.measurement_convention: Daily measurement convention: observations are compared by America/New_York calendar date; no intraday observation time is verified.

hypothesis.summary: A synthetic hypothesis on two Treasury maturities for lifecycle tests.

limitations.text: Submitted manually and frozen before its outcome, outside the project's model adapter, which does not rule out AI assistance; the engine record states how it was authored.
limitations.title: Manual submission

limitations.text: FRED observations are compared by America/New_York date. Treasury quotes are taken at or near 3:30 PM with no documented bound, so no intraday observation time is claimed.
limitations.title: Daily measurement convention

limitations.text: Reference history comes only from the baseline snapshot bound at freeze; scored dates come from the named outcome snapshot. A vintage date is FRED's real-time period, and a retrieval time shows possession, not first publication.
limitations.title: Pinned snapshots

limitations.text: Two maturities of one yield curve demonstrate the lifecycle; they are not independent observations, and showcase cases never enter research scores.
limitations.title: Not independent evidence

limitations.text: Labels describe whether later observations were consistent with the frozen hypothesis. They do not show that the event caused the move and are not significance tests.
limitations.title: No causal proof

research.reason: Showcase cases never enter research scores.
